rules: Paired spotted markings running from the temples/head down the sides of the neck/body are the primary recurring host-species cue in the DS9-era visual model.
Spot pattern belongs to persistent individual morphology and must remain recognizable across later portraits.
Joined status is not visible by default and must not be guessed from appearance.
Humanlike facial, skin-tone, hair and body variation remains broad.
forbidden_variation: one spot map cloned across NPCs
notes: Symbiont identity is separate; host portrait does not reveal private joining state unless World State makes it visible/known.
